items: Dragging an edge on the timeline (a song, section, music start or end, drop, cut, or the Export and clip handles) now moves the playhead with it and draws a line through the timeline at that spot.
Timeline lanes can be resized: S, M or L for all lanes, Option-scroll for in between, or drag a lane's bottom edge to size just that lane. The lane names column can be dragged wider too.
Panel resize handles have a clearer look and show the size while you drag.
The Cuts panel's "Cut every" list shows which sections are on Auto, and a changed section has its own reset button.
Timeline menus no longer run off the screen, and putting a setting back to its default no longer marks it as custom.
Icons throughout the app: step tabs, menus, panel headers, lane names and buttons.
